header.title: Level 3: the curve book
header.briefing: Clients ask in the 2Y, 5Y, 10Y and 30Y. Your risk is a curve, not a number: price each request by what it does to the WHOLE book, then decide where (and whether) to hedge. Limits: total DV01, and slope exposure.
